text: {"lessons":["I sold three positions after gains, but a profitable sale is not automatically the best choice; I should decide based on my portfolio plan and the holding’s prospects.","My account value fluctuated even during months when I made no trades, so I should not react to every move or assume trading can prevent ordinary volatility.","A short record cannot show whether my decisions were good or predict future prices; I should use clear reasons for trades rather than judging them by recent outcomes."]}
